scope: Research coverage, not certification, a market-share ranking, or an exhaustive list of all providers. No vendor has been tested end to end with this build.

platforms.name: Google Meet
platforms.guidance: Choose Window → Cue Share View when window sharing is permitted. Entire-screen sharing is a separate capture path and can show Cue.

platforms.name: Zoom
platforms.guidance: Select the Cue Share View window, then check a second participant's picture. Zoom capture modes differ; a result for one mode does not certify the others.

platforms.name: Microsoft Teams
platforms.guidance: Choose the specific Cue Share View window. Teams documents screen and window sharing, including the native macOS picker. Organisation policy can limit sharing.

platforms.name: Outlook meeting invitations
platforms.guidance: Check the meeting link's provider and use its guidance. Outlook schedules online meetings; it is not one independent screen-capture implementation.

platforms.name: Cisco Webex
platforms.guidance: Select the individual Cue Share View window. Check whether your client is sharing one window, all windows of an application, or the whole desktop.

platforms.name: Slack Huddles
platforms.guidance: Choose the Cue Share View window in the sharing picker. Check the recipient view; do not treat a full-screen share as the same mode.

platforms.name: Discord
platforms.guidance: Go Live supports an application window or a whole screen. Select Cue Share View as the window and verify the recipient view.

platforms.name: Lark Meetings
platforms.guidance: Choose the Cue Share View window. Lark documents both desktop and window sharing; minimising a shared window can pause its presentation.

platforms.name: Whereby
platforms.guidance: Choose Application Window → Cue Share View. Share View carries video only; microphone and any shared computer audio have separate controls.

platforms.name: Jitsi Meet
platforms.guidance: Screen sharing exists, but Jitsi deployments can configure capture and recording. Inspect the actual browser picker; use Share View only if a window is accepted.

platforms.name: FaceTime on Mac
platforms.guidance: Use Share This Window on Cue Share View. Apple separately offers the entire screen and all application windows; verify which one is active.

platforms.name: GoTo Meeting
platforms.guidance: Screen sharing is documented, but this client's precise capture mode has not been verified. Inspect its current picker before attempting Share View.

platforms.name: Mercor AI interviews / tasks
platforms.guidance: Requirements vary by role and task. Do not assume that a conversational interview and a screen-sharing task use the same setup. Share View requires an accepted window source.

platforms.name: HireVue
platforms.guidance: HireVue offers on-demand and live interviews; some live sessions use Zoom, Teams or Webex. Confirm the actual provider and any separate screen-recording requirement.

platforms.name: CoderPad Interview
platforms.guidance: The shared editor and embedded video are separate from desktop capture. Editor actions may be recorded regardless of what a screen-share picture contains. Exact window-picker support remains unverified.

platforms.name: HackerRank browser Interview
platforms.guidance: Browser interviews can include integrated calls and sharing. Check the organisation's interview configuration. Desktop App Mode has additional restrictions and is listed separately.

platforms.name: HackerRank Chakra Desktop App Mode
platforms.guidance: Unsupported with Share View under the documented restrictions: other applications and recording/sharing tools are blocked. Cue does not bypass those controls.

platforms.name: HackerEarth SmartBrowser
platforms.guidance: Unsupported with Share View under the documented restrictions. SmartBrowser checks running applications and automatically captures the full screen; it does not ask you to choose a window.

platforms.name: CodeSignal certified / proctored assessments
platforms.guidance: The documented assessment setup requires the entire screen. Selecting Share View would not satisfy that requirement, and independent full-screen capture can show Cue.

platforms.name: Spark Hire
platforms.guidance: Live and one-way video interviews are different modes. The product page does not establish screen-capture behaviour or Cue compatibility. Verify the exact interview setup.

platforms.name: Willo
platforms.guidance: Recorded video responses do not by themselves establish what other monitoring is enabled. Capture requirements and permitted assistance must be checked for the specific interview.

platforms.name: VidCruiter
platforms.guidance: Supports live and pre-recorded video interviews. Exact capture sources and organisation settings have not been verified; there is no platform-wide invisibility result.

platforms.name: interviewstream
platforms.guidance: On-demand interviews record responses to preset questions. That does not establish desktop-capture support or its absence. Check the actual interview configuration.

platforms.name: Karat
platforms.guidance: Karat documents live technical assessment with an Interview Engineer and IDE. Exact screen-capture behaviour is unverified; shared code and recorded conversation are separate data channels.

platforms.name: iMocha Live Interview
platforms.guidance: Configurable window-violation monitoring can report leaving the interview window. Excluding Cue from a picture does not remove those events. Confirm the permitted setup.

platforms.name: Mercer Mettl Secure Exam Browser
platforms.guidance: The secure browser restricts applications. Share View is unsupported unless the assessment operator explicitly permits the required apps and a window-sharing workflow.

platforms.name: Talview Secure Browser
platforms.guidance: The documented secure mode prevents access to other tabs and applications. Share View is not a solution for that mode and does not change its restrictions.

platforms.name: TestGorilla assessments
platforms.guidance: TestGorilla documents signals including fullscreen exits, tab switching, webcam status and paste activity. Screen exclusion does not conceal these separate signals; check assessment rules.
